transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile, this is Tom. What can I do for you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Tom, my phone keeps saying no service since I put the new SIM in yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so since you put the new S-Net SIM in yesterday, the phone shows no service at all. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, nothing at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's sort that out. First I'll need to verify you. Can you answer your security question for me: what was the name of your first school?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hillside Primary.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Fiona, that's all verified. Is the phone itself locked to another network, do you know? Did you buy it from another provider?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I bought it from Vodafone two years ago, but I paid it off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. When you go into settings, then about phone, is there a line that says carrier lock or network lock?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hang on. It says SIM lock, no SIM restrictions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, so it isn't locked. Is there an icon at the top of the screen, like a red signal bar or an exclamation mark?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's a little red light on the case actually, on the side.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is that light red all the time, or does it flash?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Red all the time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I've just pushed a network refresh to your SIM from my side. Could you restart the phone for me?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's restarting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the light still red now, after the restart?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, it's gone. And I've got four bars now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's what I hoped. The SIM hadn't fully activated on our network; the refresh has completed it. Could you make a quick test call or send a text to make sure it works both ways?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Texted my husband, he's replied already.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So your SIM is active and your service is working normally. Is there anything else that isn't working on the phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's it. Thank you, Tom.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Fiona. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and enjoy the rest of your day.
